plugin.name: SquareSoft_Core_Triggers
plugin.author: OpenAI
plugin.purpose: Portable SquareSoft status colouring and cooldown notices
plugin.description:
SQUARESOFT CORE TRIGGERS v1.10
Portable replacements for SquareSoft triggers that previously lived in the MUSHclient world file.
Included: * HP current-value green -> red gradient on the <<HP: ... MP: ...>> line * MP current/max cyan -> light-purple -> red gradient * OVERALL CONDITION HP/SP percentage gradients * red "Mob", light-green "Exp", fixed green << and >> * six-line magenta "You can use chakra again." ready notice
Commands: ss core status ss core on|off ss core notices on|off
All trigger names are stable and live in group SS_CORE.

muclient.script:
CORE_TRIGGER_GROUP = "SS_CORE" GAUGE_PLUGIN_ID = "d47f6a92e1b83c5f0a9e2716" LEARNED_TRIGGER_NAME = "SS_CORE_LEARNED_HPMP"
local coreEnabled = GetVariable("core_enabled") ~= "false" local chakraNoticesEnabled = GetVariable("chakra_notices_enabled") ~= "false"
local learnedHP = nil local learnedMP = nil
local function Clamp(value, low, high) value = tonumber(value) or low if value < low then return low end if value > high then return high end return value end
local function Round(value) return math.floor((tonumber(value) or 0) + 0.5) end
local function RGBName(r, g, b) r = Clamp(Round(r), 0, 255) g = Clamp(Round(g), 0, 255) b = Clamp(Round(b), 0, 255) -- MUSHclient colour integers use Windows COLORREF order: rr + gg*256 + bb*65536. return RGBColourToName(r + g * 256 + b * 65536) end
local function Lerp(a, b, t) return a + (b - a) * t end
-- Keep the status-line colours identical to the cockpit gauges. -- The old two-channel red<->green lerp produced muddy brown around 40%. local HP_STOPS = { {100, {65, 255, 95}}, {80, {120, 255, 70}}, {60, {225, 245, 55}}, {40, {255, 180, 45}}, {20, {255, 95, 45}}, {0, {255, 45, 55}} }
local MP_STOPS = { {100, {60, 235, 255}}, {50, {180, 70, 255}}, {0, {255, 65, 75}} }
local function GradientName(percent, stops) local p = Clamp(percent, 0, 100)
for i = 1, #stops - 1 do local highP, highC = stops[i][1], stops[i][2] local lowP, lowC = stops[i + 1][1], stops[i + 1][2]
if p <= highP and p >= lowP then local span = highP - lowP local t = span > 0 and ((p - lowP) / span) or 0
return RGBName( Lerp(lowC[1], highC[1], t), Lerp(lowC[2], highC[2], t), Lerp(lowC[3], highC[3], t) ) end end
local c = stops[#stops][2] return RGBName(c[1], c[2], c[3]) end
local function HPGradient(percent) return GradientName(percent, HP_STOPS) end
local function MPGradient(percent) return GradientName(percent, MP_STOPS) end
local function SafePercent(current, maximum) current = tonumber(current) or 0 maximum = tonumber(maximum) or 0 if maximum <= 0 then return 0 end return Clamp((current / maximum) * 100, 0, 100) end
local function LoadLearnedGaugeCalibration() local hpPattern = GetVariable("learned_hp_pattern") local hpMode = GetVariable("learned_hp_mode") local hpRegex = GetVariable("learned_hp_regex") local mpPattern = GetVariable("learned_mp_pattern") local mpMode = GetVariable("learned_mp_mode") local mpRegex = GetVariable("learned_mp_regex") local hpLineRegex = GetVariable("learned_hp_line_regex") local mpLineRegex = GetVariable("learned_mp_line_regex")
if not hpPattern or hpPattern == "" or not hpRegex or hpRegex == "" or not mpPattern or mpPattern == "" or not mpRegex or mpRegex == "" then learnedHP = nil learnedMP = nil return false end
learnedHP = { pattern = hpPattern, mode = hpMode, regex = hpRegex, lineRegex = hpLineRegex }
learnedMP = { pattern = mpPattern, mode = mpMode, regex = mpRegex, lineRegex = mpLineRegex }
return true end
local function SaveLearnedGaugeCalibration() if learnedHP and learnedMP then SetVariable("learned_hp_pattern", tostring(learnedHP.pattern or "")) SetVariable("learned_hp_mode", tostring(learnedHP.mode or "")) SetVariable("learned_hp_regex", tostring(learnedHP.regex or "")) SetVariable("learned_mp_pattern", tostring(learnedMP.pattern or "")) SetVariable("learned_mp_mode", tostring(learnedMP.mode or "")) SetVariable("learned_mp_regex", tostring(learnedMP.regex or "")) SetVariable("learned_hp_line_regex", tostring(learnedHP.lineRegex or "")) SetVariable("learned_mp_line_regex", tostring(learnedMP.lineRegex or "")) else SetVariable("learned_hp_pattern", "") SetVariable("learned_hp_mode", "") SetVariable("learned_hp_regex", "") SetVariable("learned_mp_pattern", "") SetVariable("learned_mp_mode", "") SetVariable("learned_mp_regex", "") SetVariable("learned_hp_line_regex", "") SetVariable("learned_mp_line_regex", "") end end
local function ApplyLearnedGradientTrigger() if not learnedHP or not learnedMP then SetTriggerOption(LEARNED_TRIGGER_NAME, "match", "(?!)") EnableTrigger(LEARNED_TRIGGER_NAME, false) return false end
local hpLineRegex = tostring(learnedHP.lineRegex or "") local mpLineRegex = tostring(learnedMP.lineRegex or "")
local match
if hpLineRegex ~= "" and mpLineRegex ~= "" then -- The stored calibration sample defines the legitimate status-line -- shape. Only those full-line fingerprints may activate the learned -- gradient, even if HP-like text appears elsewhere in game output. if hpLineRegex == mpLineRegex then match = hpLineRegex else match = "(?:" .. hpLineRegex .. "|" .. mpLineRegex .. ")" end else -- Legacy calibration fallback for users who have not yet stored a -- reference sample. New v2.11+ calibrations always use line fingerprints. match = "^.*(?:" .. tostring(learnedHP.regex or "") .. "|" .. tostring(learnedMP.regex or "") .. ").*$" end
local rc = SetTriggerOption( LEARNED_TRIGGER_NAME, "match", match )
if rc ~= error_code.eOK then EnableTrigger(LEARNED_TRIGGER_NAME, false) return false end
EnableTrigger(LEARNED_TRIGGER_NAME, coreEnabled) return true end
function SetGaugeCalibration( hpPattern, hpMode, hpRegex, mpPattern, mpMode, mpRegex, hpLineRegex, mpLineRegex ) hpPattern = tostring(hpPattern or "") hpMode = tostring(hpMode or "") hpRegex = tostring(hpRegex or "") mpPattern = tostring(mpPattern or "") mpMode = tostring(mpMode or "") mpRegex = tostring(mpRegex or "") hpLineRegex = tostring(hpLineRegex or "") mpLineRegex = tostring(mpLineRegex or "")
if hpPattern == "" or hpRegex == "" or mpPattern == "" or mpRegex == "" then return "invalid" end
if (hpMode ~= "percent" and hpMode ~= "currentmax" and hpMode ~= "currentmax_percent") or (mpMode ~= "percent" and mpMode ~= "currentmax" and mpMode ~= "currentmax_percent") then return "invalid" end
learnedHP = { pattern = hpPattern, mode = hpMode, regex = hpRegex, lineRegex = hpLineRegex }
learnedMP = { pattern = mpPattern, mode = mpMode, regex = mpRegex, lineRegex = mpLineRegex }
SaveLearnedGaugeCalibration() ApplyLearnedGradientTrigger() pcall(SaveState) return "ok" end
function ClearGaugeCalibration() learnedHP = nil learnedMP = nil SaveLearnedGaugeCalibration() ApplyLearnedGradientTrigger() pcall(SaveState) return "ok" end
local function ParseLearnedField(spec, line, kind) if not spec then return nil end
local s, e, first, second = tostring(line or ""):find(spec.pattern)
if not s then return nil end
local firstText = tostring(first or ""):gsub(",", "") local secondText = tostring(second or ""):gsub(",", "") first = tonumber(firstText) second = tonumber(secondText)
if not first then return nil end
local percent
if spec.mode == "percent" then percent = Clamp(first, 0, 100) else if not second or second <= 0 then return nil end percent = SafePercent(first, second) end
return { startPos = s, endPos = e, percent = percent, kind = kind, mode = spec.mode } end
local function LearnedFieldsForLine(line) if not learnedHP or not learnedMP then return {} end
local fields = {} local hpField = ParseLearnedField(learnedHP, line, "hp") local mpField = ParseLearnedField(learnedMP, line, "mp")
if hpField then fields[#fields + 1] = hpField end if mpField then fields[#fields + 1] = mpField end
table.sort( fields, function(a, b) return a.startPos < b.startPos end )
return fields end
local function LearnedLineMatches(line) local fields = LearnedFieldsForLine(line) return #fields > 0 end
local function LearnedOverrideSpans(line, fields) local spans = {}
for _, field in ipairs(fields or {}) do local fieldText = tostring(line or ""):sub( field.startPos, field.endPos )
local numeric = {} local pos = 1
while true do local s, e = fieldText:find( "%d[%d,]*%.?%d*", pos )
if not s then break end
numeric[#numeric + 1] = { startPos = field.startPos + s - 1, endPos = field.startPos + e - 1 }
pos = e + 1 end
local count = 1
-- Apply the gradient to every numeric component that belongs to the -- calibrated gauge field, while preserving separators/brackets/labels -- in the MUD's original styles. if field.mode == "currentmax" then count = 2
-- Backward compatibility for calibrations saved before compound -- current/max + displayed-percent fields were explicitly learned. -- If a percentage immediately follows the learned current/max -- value (eg. "11061/11061: 100%"), include that percentage in the -- same gradient without forcing the user to recalibrate. local suffix = tostring(line or ""):sub( field.endPos + 1, math.min(#tostring(line or ""), field.endPos + 24) ) local relStart, relEnd = suffix:find( "^%s*:%s*%d[%d,]*%.?%d*%s*%%" )
if relStart then local numberStart, numberEnd = suffix:find("%d[%d,]*%.?%d*", relStart)
if numberStart then numeric[#numeric + 1] = { startPos = field.endPos + numberStart, endPos = field.endPos + numberEnd } count = 3 end end elseif field.mode == "currentmax_percent" then count = 3 end
local colour = field.kind == "hp" and HPGradient(field.percent) or MPGradient(field.percent)
for i = 1, math.min(count, #numeric) do spans[#spans + 1] = { startPos = numeric[i].startPos, endPos = numeric[i].endPos, colour = colour } end end
table.sort( spans, function(a, b) return a.startPos < b.startPos end )
return spans end
local function OverrideColourAt(spans, position) for _, span in ipairs(spans or {}) do if position >= span.startPos and position <= span.endPos then return span.colour end end
return nil end
local function EmitStyledSegment(text, style, overrideColour) if not text or text == "" then return end
local fg = overrideColour or RGBColourToName( tonumber(style and style.textcolour) or 0 )
local bg = RGBColourToName( tonumber(style and style.backcolour) or 0 )
NoteStyle( tonumber(style and style.style) or 0 )
ColourTell( fg, bg, text ) end
local function EmitPreservedStyledLine(line, styles, overrideSpans) line = tostring(line or "")
if type(styles) ~= "table" or #styles == 0 then -- Never flatten a MUD-formatted bar merely to apply the gradient. -- If style metadata is unexpectedly unavailable, fail open and show -- the original text without our colour override. NoteStyle(0) Note(line) return end
local absolutePos = 1
for _, style in ipairs(styles) do local styleText = tostring(style.text or "") local styleLength = #styleText local localPos = 1
while localPos <= styleLength do local globalPos = absolutePos + localPos - 1 local override = OverrideColourAt( overrideSpans, globalPos )
local runEnd = localPos
while runEnd < styleLength do local nextGlobal = absolutePos + runEnd
if OverrideColourAt( overrideSpans, nextGlobal ) ~= override then break end
runEnd = runEnd + 1 end
EmitStyledSegment( styleText:sub( localPos, runEnd ), style, override )
localPos = runEnd + 1 end
absolutePos = absolutePos + styleLength end
NoteStyle(0) Note("") end
function ColourLearnedStats(name, line, wildcards, styles) local text = tostring(line or "") local fields = LearnedFieldsForLine(text)
if #fields == 0 then -- This should not normally happen because the trigger itself is -- generated from the learned regexes. Fail open if they ever drift. NoteStyle(0) Note(text) return end
-- Preserve every original MUD style run and overlay only the numeric -- portions that the HP/MP gradient owns. EmitPreservedStyledLine( text, styles, LearnedOverrideSpans(text, fields) ) end
function ColourStats(name, line, wildcards) -- If the learned gradient already owns this line, do not redraw it a -- second time through the legacy fixed-format trigger. if LearnedLineMatches(line) then return end
-- Match broadly at the trigger layer, then parse the actual visible line here. -- This keeps the portable colouring tolerant of harmless spacing changes in -- the MUD prompt while still failing open if the format changes materially. local lead, open, hpLabel, hpCurrent, hpSlash, hpMax, mpLabel, mpCurrent, mpSlash, mpMax, close, trail = tostring(line or ""):match( "^(%s*)(<<)(HP:%s*)(%d+)(/)(%d+)(%s*MP:%s*)(%d+)(/)(%d+)(>>)(%s*)$" )
if not open then Note(line or "") return end
local hpColour = HPGradient(SafePercent(hpCurrent, hpMax)) local mpColour = MPGradient(SafePercent(mpCurrent, mpMax))
ColourTell("white", "", lead or "") ColourTell("green", "", open) ColourTell("white", "", hpLabel) ColourTell(hpColour, "", hpCurrent) ColourTell("white", "", hpSlash) ColourTell(hpColour, "", hpMax) ColourTell("white", "", mpLabel) ColourTell(mpColour, "", mpCurrent) ColourTell("white", "", mpSlash) ColourTell(mpColour, "", mpMax) ColourTell("green", "", close) ColourTell("white", "", trail or "") Note("") end
function ColourCondition(name, line, wildcards) -- Learned calibration may deliberately target the condition line itself. -- In that case the dynamic gradient trigger owns the redraw. if LearnedLineMatches(line) then return end
local lead, open, prefix, hpPercent, hpToSP, spPercent, spToMob, mobLabel, mobTail, expLabel, expTail, close, trail = tostring(line or ""):match( "^(%s*)(<<)(OVERALL CONDITION:%s*<HP:%s*)(%d+)(%%>%s*<SP:%s*)(%d+)(%%>%s*<)(Mob)(:%s*[^>]*>%s*)(Exp)(:%s*[%d%.]+%%%s*)(>>)(%s*)$" )
if not open then Note(line or "") return end
local hpColour = HPGradient(tonumber(hpPercent) or 0) local spColour = MPGradient(tonumber(spPercent) or 0)
ColourTell("white", "", lead or "") ColourTell("green", "", open) ColourTell("white", "", prefix) ColourTell(hpColour, "", hpPercent) ColourTell("white", "", hpToSP) ColourTell(spColour, "", spPercent) ColourTell("white", "", spToMob) ColourTell("#FF0000", "", mobLabel) ColourTell("white", "", mobTail) ColourTell("#90EE90", "", expLabel) ColourTell("white", "", expTail) ColourTell("green", "", close) ColourTell("white", "", trail or "") Note("") end
function ChakraReadyNotice(name, line, wildcards) if not chakraNoticesEnabled then -- This trigger omits the server line so the portable colourized form owns -- the display. When notices are disabled, reproduce one normal line. Note(line or "You can use chakra again.") return end
for i = 1, 6 do ColourNote("magenta", "", line or "You can use chakra again.") end end
local function SetCoreEnabled(enabled) coreEnabled = enabled and true or false SetVariable("core_enabled", coreEnabled and "true" or "false") EnableGroup(CORE_TRIGGER_GROUP, coreEnabled) ApplyLearnedGradientTrigger() end
-- Public API used by the suite installer during v1.x -> v2.0 migration. function SetPortableEnabled(value) local enabled = (value == true) or tostring(value or ""):lower() == "true" or tostring(value or "") == "1" SetCoreEnabled(enabled) return coreEnabled and "true" or "false" end
function CoreEnableAlias(name, line, wildcards) SetCoreEnabled(tostring(wildcards[1] or ""):lower() == "on") ColourNote(coreEnabled and "lime" or "yellow", "", "[SquareSoft Core] " .. (coreEnabled and "enabled." or "disabled.")) end
function CoreStatusAlias(name, line, wildcards) ColourNote(coreEnabled and "lime" or "yellow", "", "[SquareSoft Core] Portable core triggers are " .. (coreEnabled and "ON." or "OFF.")) ColourNote("gray", "", " Chakra ready notice: " .. (chakraNoticesEnabled and "ON" or "OFF")) ColourNote( "gray", "", " Learned HP/MP gradient: " .. ((learnedHP and learnedMP) and ((learnedHP.lineRegex and learnedHP.lineRegex ~= "") and "ACTIVE (stored-line gated)" or "ACTIVE (legacy field-only)") or "built-in only") ) end
function CoreNoticesAlias(name, line, wildcards) chakraNoticesEnabled = tostring(wildcards[1] or ""):lower() == "on" SetVariable("chakra_notices_enabled", chakraNoticesEnabled and "true" or "false") ColourNote("lime", "", "[SquareSoft Core] Chakra ready notice " .. (chakraNoticesEnabled and "enabled." or "disabled.")) end
function OnPluginInstall() LoadLearnedGaugeCalibration() EnableGroup(CORE_TRIGGER_GROUP, coreEnabled) ApplyLearnedGradientTrigger() end
function OnPluginEnable() LoadLearnedGaugeCalibration() EnableGroup(CORE_TRIGGER_GROUP, coreEnabled) ApplyLearnedGradientTrigger() end
